brief:
Settlers attacked a Palestinian family as they harvested olives in Agziwa, an area near the town of Carmel adjacent to Masafer Yatta, Maan Wire reported. The incident occurred during olive-picking season in the West Bank locality.

Details of injuries or property damage were not immediately available. The attack is one of numerous incidents involving settlers in areas near Palestinian communities in the southern West Bank.
title: Settlers attack Palestinian family picking olives in Masafer Yatta area
